description: A utility object providing helper functions for Hadoop output operations within Apache Spark, including job ID creation, path handling, output metrics, and validation control.

classes.name: SparkHadoopWriterUtils
classes.description: A singleton object with utility methods for Hadoop output operations in Spark.

methods.name: createJobID
methods.description: Creates a JobID using a timestamp and job number.

methods.name: createJobID
methods.description: Creates a JobID from a job tracker ID string and job number.

methods.name: createJobTrackerID
methods.description: Generates a unique job tracker ID string based on current time and randomness.

methods.name: createPathFromString
methods.description: Converts a string path into a qualified Hadoop Path object.

methods.name: isOutputSpecValidationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Hadoop output specification validation is enabled based on SparkConf and dynamic variable.

methods.name: initHadoopOutputMetrics
methods.description: Initializes output metrics and callback for a Spark task.

methods.name: maybeUpdateOutputMetrics
methods.description: Updates output metrics periodically based on records written.
